segments.text: If you work with 3D CAD models on Windows, you know the frustration. Opening SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or Blender just to inspect a single part takes minutes and eats gigabytes of memory.
segments.subtitle: Opening bulky CAD tools just to check a part takes minutes.
segments.title: The CAD Workflow Problem

segments.text: Welcome to ModelPeek. ModelPeek is an ultra-fast, lightweight 3D preview extension seamlessly integrated into the Windows Shell.
segments.subtitle: Native Windows Shell 3D Preview Extension
segments.title: Introducing ModelPeek

segments.text: First, ModelPeek automatically generates crystal-clear 3D thumbnails for STEP, STL, and OBJ formats, allowing you to identify parts at a glance without ever opening a CAD suite.
segments.subtitle: Instant 3D thumbnails directly in Windows Explorer folders.
segments.title: Native 3D Thumbnail Provider

segments.text: Second, click the Windows Explorer preview pane, and you immediately get a full 6-degree-of-freedom interactive 3D viewport powered by hardware-accelerated WebGL.
segments.subtitle: Full 6-DOF Orbit Controls & Hardware-Accelerated WebGL
segments.title: Interactive Preview Pane Handler

segments.text: ModelPeek features studio lighting, ACES filmic tone mapping, shaded-with-edges rendering, and a dedicated wireframe mode for inspecting complex topology.
segments.subtitle: Studio Lighting, ACES Tone Mapping & Wireframe Topology
segments.title: Professional CAD Visualizer

segments.text: Switch instantly between Isometric, Top, Front, and Right orthographic views, or hit Fit to center your model. Plus, inspect bounding dimensions, vertex counts, and face counts directly on the HUD.
segments.subtitle: Top / Front / Right Views & Real-time Bounding Box Stats
segments.title: HUD Inspection & Camera Presets

segments.text: Best of all, ModelPeek is completely self-contained and portable. It runs locally inside a low-integrity preview sandbox, ensuring maximum security and zero background CPU overhead.
segments.subtitle: Self-contained portable architecture with zero background services.
segments.title: Zero Bloat & Sandbox Security

segments.text: Upgrade your Windows workflow today with ModelPeek. Free, open source, and available right now on GitHub.
segments.subtitle: 100% Free & Open Source on GitHub
segments.title: Get ModelPeek Now
